description: The SlabLineage grading calculator for a raw Pokémon or One Piece card: net result at PSA and TAG 9 and 10 after the grading fee, the recommended tier and a verdict. Uses the website's default selling fees (13.25% plus $0.40 per order, no shipping) unless you pass your own.

cardId.description: SlabLineage card id (the number in https://slablineage.com/card/{id}).

psaTier.description: PSA service tier name; default is the cheapest tier that covers the 10 price.

tagTier.description: TAG service tier name; default is the cheapest tier that covers the 10 price.

name: grade_math
title: Should I grade this?
